description: Automerge reference corpus for SHARED-OBJECTS-TEST-VECTORS-01: for each behavioral scenario, the exact Automerge changes (dependencies first), the full-save image of the converged document, its logical state and its scalar conflict sets. Generated by generate_automerge_reference_01.mjs; supplementary, not byte-normative (SHARED-OBJECTS-PROFILE-01 §14).

conventions.strings: every string value is an Automerge scalar string (ImmutableString), never Text
conventions.conflicts: conflicts[object-id][field] lists the concurrent values of a scalar field, sorted; conflicts[object-id][''] counts concurrent objects under one Object ID (an OBJECT_ID_COLLISION)

snapshot.note: full-save image taken before the post-snapshot change; load it, then apply the changes it does not contain

scenarios.description: Write to an object with a scalar conflict

negatives.description: A Data Unit signed by andrey whose plaintext carries a change by pavel's Automerge actor, on top of S01
negatives.rule: SHARED-OBJECTS-PROFILE-01 §8, §11: the change's actor MUST be the §8 actor of the Data Unit's signer; a receiver MUST NOT merge a change of any other actor.

negatives.description: andrey's own change on S01 with its first checksum byte flipped
negatives.note: change is the change before corruption; plaintext_hex frames the corrupted bytes. Automerge 3.5.0 parses them without checking the checksum.
negatives.rule: SHARED-OBJECTS-PROFILE-01 §11, §13, §74.1: a receiver MUST verify the chunk type and checksum and rejects invalid Automerge bytes with PROFILE_INVALID and the diagnostic INVALID_AUTOMERGE_BYTES.

negatives.description: A Data Unit plaintext that frames S01's full save (a document chunk) instead of a change
negatives.rule: SHARED-OBJECTS-PROFILE-01 §11, §13, §74.1: a receiver MUST verify the chunk type and checksum and rejects invalid Automerge bytes with PROFILE_INVALID and the diagnostic INVALID_AUTOMERGE_BYTES.

validations.description: The S01 Task with Text inside extensions (a map value and a list item), in an unknown field, in status and in due
validations.rule: SHARED-OBJECTS-PROFILE-01 §30, §74.1: every string in any object is a scalar string; Text is INVALID_FIELD_TYPE at its own pointer, before the field's own rule.

validations.description: The S01 Task with a tags member whose value is Text
validations.rule: SHARED-OBJECTS-PROFILE-01 §30, §74.1: INVALID_FIELD_TYPE comes before INVALID_COLLECTION_REPRESENTATION at the same pointer.

validations.description: The S01 document whose root profile value is Text
validations.rule: SHARED-OBJECTS-PROFILE-01 §15, §30, §74.1: the root profile must be the scalar profile identifier; otherwise INVALID_ROOT.

validations.description: The S01 Task whose extensions nest maps exactly 64 levels deep
validations.rule: SHARED-OBJECTS-PROFILE-01 §30: maps and lists nest at most 64 levels in an object (the field's own map is depth 1).

validations.description: The S01 Task whose extensions nest maps 65 levels deep
validations.rule: SHARED-OBJECTS-PROFILE-01 §30, §74.1: the map at depth 65 is INVALID_FIELD_TYPE at its own pointer; nothing below it is examined.
